anna_sales: Jules' team needs a POC design: SD-WAN -> TGW (active/active). Primary PrivateLink in us-east-1, fallback to an egress proxy in us-west-2. Must preserve client source IP and use mTLS. Also need firewall ports and rough cost delta vs Hosted.

diego_se: Short answer: one interface endpoint per region. Front with a TCP NLB (preserves src IP to instance targets). Avoid SNAT/NAT gateways. For mTLS, terminate at connector or pass-through; we'll need cert exchange. Region failover via BGP local-pref or TGW route update automation.

maria_netops: Firewall checklist (minimal): allow TCP 443 from spoke/TGW to endpoint ENIs; allow NLB health-check ranges to connector health port (e.g., 8080); if proxy used, allow spoke->proxy 443 and proxy->primary NLB 443 for probes. MTU note: SD-WAN overlays require MSS clamp.

anna_sales: Action: diego write cert/mTLS steps, maria draft BGP runbook + MSS note, I'll request access for SG/IP ranges. Drop deliverables in ticket POC-51320 by EOD.

jules_customer: Thanks, please include a 1TB/month cost sketch for endpoint+NLB+cross-region egress.
